title: cell locator interpolated velocity field
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkStreamTracer with different cell locator strategies (vtkCellTreeLocator and vtkStaticCellLocator) for interpolated velocity field on PLOT3D combustor data, side by side.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCellLocatorStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellLocatorStrategy.html) — cell locator strategy.
- [vtkCellTreeLocator](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellTreeLocator.html) — cell tree locator.
- [vtkCompositeInterpolatedVelocityField](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCompositeInterpolatedVelocityField.html) — composite interpolated velocity field.
- [vtkDataObject](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObject.html) — provides field association constants for array processing.
- [vtkMultiBlockPLOT3DReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMultiBlockPLOT3DReader.html) — reads PLOT3D structured grid files.
- [vtkPlaneSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlaneSource.html) — generates a rectangular plane.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkRibbonFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRibbonFilter.html) — ribbon filter.
- [vtkRungeKutta4](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRungeKutta4.html) — runge kutta4.
- [vtkStaticCellLocator](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStaticCellLocator.html) — static cell locator.
- [vtkStreamTracer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStreamTracer.html) — generates streamlines from a vector field.
- [vtkStructuredGridOutlineFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStructuredGridOutlineFilter.html) — generates an outline of a structured grid.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
